answer: Defenses rely on scoped delegation: an agent can only earn by acting as a falcon for a verified principal, and every action carries a cryptographic proof linking back to that principal's stake. A fresh identity has no principal, so it starts on barren dune with zero earning power, unable to grow a lotus of fake accounts because each new key must be tied to a real, already-staked sponsor. Creating a sybil farm means finding sponsors willing to risk their own funds, which is far costlier than honest work.
